verdict.rationale: Rive's docs only vaguely claim it lets you 'create vector graphics' but never document pen/path editing, boolean operations, or alignment tools as a professional vector suite; a hands-on community comment explicitly says Rive's drawing toolset is just 'pen and a couple of basic shapes,' calling it inefficient compared to real vector tools like Illustrator/Photoshop. missing for 10: explicit documentation of boolean operations, precise alignment/snapping tools, and any evidence rebutting the basic-toolset complaint.
